description: This line plot, titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature,” illustrates the accuracy of three different methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—as a function of temperature, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 on the x-axis. The y-axis represents Accuracy (Pass@8), scaled linearly from 62.5 to 80.0. The On-policy RL method is depicted by a yellow line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 64.5 at temperature 0.1, peaking near 75.0 at 0.6, and ending around 72.5 at 1.0. The LUFFY method is shown as a red line with star markers, beginning at about 75.5 at 0.1, rising to a peak of approximately 80.0 at 0.8, and concluding near 79.0 at 1.0. The SFT method is represented by a teal line with triangle markers, starting at around 75.0 at 0.1, dipping to a low of approximately 70.0 at 0.5, and finishing near 74.0 at 1.0. All three lines exhibit fluctuations across the temperature range, with LUFFY generally achieving the highest accuracy, followed by SFT, and then On-policy RL.
